yt.description:
Same $60,000 of freelance profit, nine provinces, and a $2,816-a-year gap. Federal tax and CPP are the same everywhere (about $11,879); the difference is provincial tax.

Provincial tax on $60K net self-employment income (2026, single, no other income or deductions): B.C. $2,363 · Alberta $2,441 · Ontario $2,724 · Manitoba $4,227 · Nova Scotia $5,179 (highest). So the share to set aside runs from about 23.7% in B.C. to 28.4% in Nova Scotia. Québec isn't included: it has its own return and pension plan.

Next: what a $5,000 RRSP contribution does to this bill.

Sources: CRA T4127 (2026), 2026 provincial budgets, CRA self-employed CPP. Example only; general information, not tax advice.
